goal: Crafting: find and use every recipe on the crafting screen (C); are tools worth making?

findings.title: Cooked Meat is wasted by auto-eat: eaten first at <90 energy, capped at 100
findings.detail: Crafted 1 Cooked Meat (screen says '45 energy (raw: 25)'). There is no eat key or button; the player auto-eats when energy drops below 90 and always picks the most nourishing food first. The cooked meat disappeared around tick 3250-3303 (only visible cue: 'Objective complete: Eat something'), and energy went from ~90 to 99.2. So ~35 of its 45 energy was lost while the bag held 12+ apples (15 each) that would have fit exactly. Cooking a chicken (costing a wood) currently buys almost nothing. Expected: eat the smallest food that fills the gap, or let the player choose when to eat.
findings.repro: pt start --seed 107; key space; click Start/Begin; walkto tree, e; walkto chicken, e; key c; click Craft on Cooked Meat (822,265); keep gathering until energy < 90; watch the cooked_meat count drop and energy cap at 100

findings.title: No way to eat food, and no message when food is eaten automatically
findings.detail: Neither the three Controls pages, the Inventory (I) screen nor the HUD offer an eat action. The crafting screen sells Cooked Meat as '45 energy', but the player never sees it eaten: no status line or floating text, it just disappears from the inventory. Expected: a 'You ate cooked meat (+N energy)' status line, and ideally a line on the Controls page saying food is eaten automatically below 90 energy.
findings.repro: craft Cooked Meat as above; press I; open ? Controls pages 1-3

findings.title: Planks and Bricks (2 of 5 recipes) cannot be reached in a normal first session
findings.detail: Both need a Workshop, which unlocks in the Village era: 1 village, 10 members, 2 stalls, day 3. I created a nation and founded my own settlement at tick 7303, and both were still locked. At the observed 0-17 ticks a second, day 3 is hours of real time away. The lock reason is shown clearly in orange, which is good, but a crafting-focused player can't try 40% of the screen early on.
findings.repro: pt start --seed 107; gather 50 wood; key n; walk to open ground; key f; key c

findings.title: Founding a settlement: the 'open ground' hint keeps moving as AI nations claim land
findings.detail: After N, pressing F gave 'Open ground lies about 120 to the north'. After walking there: 'Too close to the Camp of Eastville... 310 to the north-west', then 'Northernford... 121 to the west', then 'claimed by Northernford... 211 to the north'. It took four tries and ~2400 ticks (objective 4) to find a legal spot, because AI nations founded camps at the same time. The hints are helpful but they chase a moving target.
findings.repro: pt start --seed 107; go to around (-27,315) with 50 wood; key n; key f; follow each hint and press f again

findings.title: Using a rock next to a tree chops the tree instead (interact priority)
findings.detail: Twice `pt walkto rock` + E chopped a nearby tree ('Gathered 8 wood...') rather than mining the rock, because interact prefers tree over rock. This is documented behaviour, but it spends axe durability when the player meant to use the pickaxe. Facing direction could break the tie.
findings.repro: walkto rock near trees (around tick 4291); e

findings.title: Very low frame/tick rate under the shared load; crafting overlay showed a frame late
findings.detail: fps 1-5 and tps 0-17 for most of the session (machine load avg ~54). The first pt start timed out after 60s with an empty game.log; the second worked. Once, state.json said CRAFTING while the screenshot still showed the world view; the overlay appeared ~2s later. Probably the environment, not the game.
findings.repro: pt start under heavy load; key c; pt shot immediately

verdict: Tools are worth making and the screen explains them well. An axe (4 wood, 2 stone) pays for itself after two trees and gives about +60 wood over 20 uses; the pickaxe gives +30 stone over 15 uses. The live 'Ready / Need N more / have 1 (19 uses left)' lines and the context 'Craft Pickaxe' HUD button are good. Cooked Meat is the weak recipe: you can't choose to eat it, and auto-eat spends it first at 89 energy, so most of its 45 energy is thrown away. Planks and Bricks can't be reached in a first session (Village era: 10 members, 2 stalls, day 3), so only 3 of the 5 recipes could be used.
